A '''diplomatic ploov''' was a piece of headgear worn by [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]]. [[Lufa Danak/Legends|Lufa Danak]] wore one during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] also wore a miter with a ploov.

==Behind the scenes==
Diplomatic ploovs first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], and were identified in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''.
